expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a very light mint background. Contrast is extremely low, so the headline and the promo code are barely legible.

On the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill overlaps the edge of the bowl illustration. The image is also washed out against its light gray background, so the card looks low-contrast and inconsistent next to the darker cards.

The heart/favorite icon on the pizza card sits on a semi-transparent dark circle that blends into the dark wood background. The white '−20%' badge is also low-emphasis, so both controls look inconsistent and have weak affordance.
